title: Auditory Illusion Benchmark for Large Audio Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.02277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Perceptual illusions have long served as crucial probes into human cognition, revealing biases and limitations of perception. In the auditory domain, such illusions provide a unique lens for testing whether Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) replicate human perceptual tendencies. Despite their importance, most benchmarks focus on visual illusions or general audio tasks, leaving auditory illusions underexplored. To this end, we present AIB, the first auditory illusion benchmark for LALMs, covering ten representative illusions across music, sound, and speech, each annotated for the presence of knowledge-based priors. Our methodology pairs model evaluation with controlled human listening studies, enabling direct comparison of responses. translated_title: 面向大音频语言模型的听觉错觉基准测试
translated_abstract: 感知错觉长期以来一直作为探究人类认知的重要手段，能够揭示知觉的偏差与局限。在听觉领域，这类错觉为检验大音频语言模型（LALMs）是否复现人类感知倾向提供了独特的视角。尽管其意义重大，现有的大多数基准测试都聚焦于视觉错觉或一般性音频任务，使听觉错觉的研究仍处于欠开发状态。为此，我们提出了AIB——首个面向大音频语言模型的听觉错觉基准，涵盖音乐、声音与语音领域中十种代表性的错觉，并对每项错觉是否涉及基于知识的先验进行了标注。我们的方法将模型评估与受控的人类听音实验相结合，从而能够对两者的反应进行直接比较。结果显示出系统性差异：大多数大音频语言模型在低层声学错觉上保持对信号的忠实，但当涉及语言或音乐先验时，若干模型表现出更接近人类的反应，尽管……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个面向大音频语言模型的听觉错觉基准AIB，通过与人类受控听音实验的直接对比发现，模型在低层声学错觉上与人类存在系统性差异，但当涉及语言或音乐先验时，部分模型会表现出更接近人类的感知反应。
en_tdlr: We present AIB, the first auditory illusion benchmark for Large Audio Language Models covering ten representative illusions across music, sound, and speech, revealing that while most LALMs remain signal-faithful on low-level acoustic illusions, several exhibit more human-like responses when linguistic or musical priors are involved.
